meta.name: Field Notes Expansion
meta.creator: CardSpoke Team
meta.description: Journal ribbon and geo pins for research logs

css:
.fn-ribbon { position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f08c2e, #f75f8a); color: #fff; text-align: center; padding: 6px 0; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); }
.fn-pin { margin-right: 6px; color: var(--accent, #f08c2e); font-weight: 700; }
